payload.summary: Optional On Call editor fields cannot be cleared on five of the six section forms
payload.detail: An optional value stored on an On Call entry cannot be removed through the editor: the owner empties the box, the save reports success, and mergeOnCallEditorDetails hands the stored value straight back. handleSave only records an emptied control as a deletion when its spec carries clearWhenEmpty, and it is set on just eight controls. FIXED ON PR #2900 for the Compliance form only (expiresOn, leadTimeDays, issuingBody, evidenceUrl, url), because a recorded expiry nobody can delete outlives the registration it describes and this page may not assert anything about the holder's standing. STILL BROKEN, 21 controls: Admin location/hours/phone/url; Contacts contactName/phone/afterHoursPhone/pager/extension/availability; Playbook escalationSteps; Referrals accepts/exclusions/catchment/hours/howToRefer/phone/fax/referralFormUrl; Teaching recurrence/nextOccurrence/nextOccurrenceDate/presenter/location/recordingUrl/topics. A wrong phone number on a ward contact is the one that matters clinically -- it can be corrected but not removed, so a decommissioned extension stays on the page and on the printed pocket card. THE FIX IS NOT SIMPLY 'flag them all': the list branch (kind list) and the escalationSteps branch in handleSave do not read clearWhenEmpty at all, so those need their own else-clause. The premise in the old clearWhenEmpty docstring -- that an empty text box cannot be told apart from a control that never rendered -- is false: handleSave iterates detailFieldsFor(), which IS the rendered set, so unrendered keys never reach it and the salvage/overlay protection for them is untouched. Deliberately not done on #2900: it changes saving behaviour on five forms that change does not otherwise touch, and it wants browser proof per form. tests/on-call-editor.dom.test.tsx has one test pinning the old behaviour for Admin 'Location' that must be updated when this is fixed.
payload.source: Codex review P2 on PR #2900, 2026-09-20; verified by agent trace of handleSave and mergeOnCallEditorDetails at 56b883ec5
